blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. The decisive deployment is Stellar token CAGYRRKPFSWKM6SJOE4QAAVYMOSHMDS5WOQ4T5A2E6XNCU7LZZKUNQKP (wasm 83bf0a7fbe1502271f2e14d2a5a46c9cde1aa213be97616bd7c6b102b342692f), whose instance binds PERM to PermissionManager CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M. Its transfer and safe_transfer methods require WHITELISTED_ROLE on both from and to, burn(account,amount,caller) burns an arbitrary account when called with BURNER_ROLE, pause is PAUSER_ROLE-gated and upgrade is owner-only. At Soroban ledger 65021030 (2026-10-19T06:22:13Z) simulateTransaction has_role returned WLISTER Some(0) for GD2ELXTHZQORSH75SJE6XRTCKXNDGJFIZ4R2SZ4MMXDOBT52GK26X4EO and Some(1) for GAUYO4UAESQD6SGZDPOIG2ADT7EZTR5EJ7HSX4CYCWS2JMMGQOCL4QCX, and BURNER Some(0) for redemption contract CAVZK26ERVGKGXLQGEOKPAQGIZS2YKN4BSXOYDMUY365EV66ZNSFEDBS. The permission-manager event history contains role_revoked|WLISTED, proving holders are de-listed through this path. The EVM deployments use the verified Spiko Token implementation (6,009-byte Token.sol core; Etherscan v2 verified), whose _update requires PermissionManager.canCall(from/to, token, 0xa9059cbb) and which exposes restricted pause(), restricted burn(address,uint256) and restricted UUPS upgrade. At Ethereum block 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z) the Ethereum authority 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 returned getRequirements(token,0xa9059cbb)=65 and a holder-to-0x...0001 transfer reverted with UnauthorizedTo 0xb77a4ad1; Arbitrum 0xa925C217e4c1C82Ee721eBD496d3863D5C2d829A and Polygon 0x344278... return the same requirement. Materiality: measured totalSupply at 2026-10-19 is 3,840,818,109,156 raw 5-decimal units: Stellar 3,576,878,729,761 (93.13%), Polygon 144,898,307,707 (3.77%), Arbitrum 106,990,105,722 (2.79%), Base 9,775,582,147 (0.25%), Ethereum 1,265,198,050 (0.03%), Starknet 1,010,185,769 (0.03%). The Stellar deployment is material and directly controlled; the EVM controls remain disclosed at sub-threshold shares. There is no declared parent; the reserve test is not reached because a direct holder control is established.

oracleRisk.summary: CACEIS Fund Administration calculates daily fund NAV and Spiko publishes the exact GBP class NAV. The gbpSAFO totals and the issuer documentation identify a centrally originated fund-pricing path, not borrower-specific liquidation or a guaranteed peg. The Chainlink Ethereum feed directory contains exactly two SAFO NAVLink feeds (SAFO NAV and EURSAFO NAV) and none for gbpSAFO, and Spiko's on-chain provider table lists no SAFO class at all. This verifies privileged internal pricing; no GBP external feed, redundancy, failover or publisher signer closure is credited.
